title: Flexjet US Praetor 500 / 600 roster (EMB-545 / EMB-550)
notes: Base roster: Flexjet fleet list (Oct 30 2025) — 94 tails (76 Praetor 500 / EMB-545, 18 Praetor 600 / EMB-550) with serial numbers. Serials 5501xxxx = Praetor 500 (EMB-545); 5502xxxx = Praetor 600 (EMB-550).
Every tail, serial and model cross-checked against the public FAA Aircraft Registry N-number inquiry; all matched.

8 additional tails are kept but flagged as not on the company fleet list dated Oct 30 2025: 6 from the earlier public-source roster plus N272FX and N273FX (FAA-registered c/o Flexjet LLC 2026). Serial/model from FAA registry.
Mode-S hex: existing observed values kept (all match FAA); missing values filled from the FAA registry 'Mode S Code (Base 16 / Hex)'. Never fabricated.
Live map filter still requires LXJ callsign + E545/E550, or a roster hex/registration match. Positions are public ADS-B only — not Flexjet dispatch/Tailwind data.
